title: DOJ Wins Court Authority to Seize $1.2 Billion of North Korea’s Stolen Binance Crypto as Freezes Top $2.7 Billion
summary: Bitcoin Magazine DOJ Wins Court Authority to Seize $1.2 Billion of North Korea’s Stolen Binance Crypto as Freezes Top $2.7 Billion The DOJ won court authority to seize $1.2 billion of North Korea's stolen Binance crypto and took down a $400 million deepfake theft scheme. This post DOJ Wins Court Authority to Seize $1.2 Billion of North Korea’s Stolen Binance Crypto as Freezes Top $2.7 Billion first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
